scope: main Java; top-level declarations; no generated Lombok methods or framework dispatch
ccPolicy: Base 1 per concrete method/constructor; +1 per if, for, foreach, while, do, catch, ternary, non-default switch label, && or ||; nested lambdas/classes excluded from parent. Decision locations included.
cboPolicy: distinct explicit imports from lt.prifkodas; proxy only, not resolved type-use CBO
ditPolicy: explicit extends chain, external root adds one edge; implicit Object excluded
